title: Crab Derby, 2009 · after
logline: The Monday after: Maria at the wall with the flyer, reading the two crabs, and turning to look at Gully through the window, and Gully behind the counter turning red in a panel that has no color. Wood on the stool draws the red in hatching.

panels.composition: The wall from the dock: MARIA reading the new flyer, the two crabs facing each other.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a woman with a dark braid on a dock reading a flyer with two crabs facing each other pinned to a shingle wall

panels.composition: MARIA turning to look through the window at the counter.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a woman turning from a wall to look through a shop window

panels.composition: GULLY behind the counter, going red — drawn in tight hatching across the cheeks.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man behind a counter with his cheeks drawn in tight cross-hatching to show a blush

panels.composition: WOOD on the stool, hatching furiously on the pad. BARNABY.
